title: observations
description: Legacy obs item {jb, entity, entity_id, field, value, observed_at, note} from PmoSyncService::pushObservations, plus external_id = "nesc:obs:{jb}:{field}:{sha8(value)}" (<= 64 chars). PMO's exchange importer consumes the row, translated to its push_observations ingest (field nesc_pole_count -> observation_type pole_count, every other field -> note). Key: external_id. Delta.

external_id.description: At most 64 characters (PMO's column); NESC's longest field name, nesc_pole_coordinates, yields about 52.

scope.description: Stamped by the builder from the manifest scope when the emitter did not set it; absent => UNSCOPED.

origin.description: Phase 1e: set to "smartsheet" on sheet-origin rows; absent on app-origin rows.

origin_ref.description: Phase 1e: {sheet, row, column, modifiedAt}; the receiver applies idempotently by origin_ref and never re-exports.
